{"implementation": "def solve(case):
    round_scores = case['round_scores']
    round_targets = case['round_targets']
    forced = case.get('forced', [])
    forced_set = set(forced)
    n = len(round_scores[0])
    active = set(range(n))
    history = []
    for scores, target in zip(round_scores, round_targets):
        # Ensure forced indices are in active set
        if not forced_set.issubset(active):
            raise ValueError('Forced index not in active set')
        # Number of slots to fill from non-forced
        slots = target - len(forced_set)
        if slots < 0:
            raise ValueError('Target smaller than number of forced indices')
        # Get candidates: active indices not forced
        candidates = list(active - forced_set)
        # Sort candidates by descending score
        candidates.sort(key=lambda i: scores[i], reverse=True)
        # Pick top slots
        selected = set(candidates[:slots])
        # Combine with forced
        round_selected = selected | forced_set
        # Build mask in original order
        mask = sorted(round_selected)
        history.append(mask)
        # Update active set
        active = round_selected
    retained_indices = sorted(active)
    return {'history': history, 'retained_indices': retained_indices}
"}
